The '''Burnout Cafetorium''' was a dining establishment which was located on the [[Zham Hlar]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]], the [[Burnout (space station)|Burnout]].

==History==
Constructed within the [[Burnout (space station)|Burnout]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in [[orbi]]t over [[Zham Hlar]], the cafetorium was an auditorium-style cafeteria which catered to the visitors and personnel of the station. Consisting of a large central room capable of seating several hundred guest at once, the cafetorium's kitchens were able to produce food to feed all of them. Live music was found at the restaurant, such as a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[holo-band]].<ref name="TAUT" />

At the height of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a deadly conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the cafetorium's kitchen was headed by [[Chef/Legends|Chef]] [[Pappi]] who oversaw a serving staff of [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. During the war, a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] named [[Xirossk]] fled the station by cutting through the cafetorium after stealing a [[PU-36 modulator chip]] from the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of the [[Heroes of Cularin]]. The heroes set out in pursuit, and they asked a number of the patrons if they had seen where Xirossk had gone. Among the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]], [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], [[Duros/Legends|Duros]], [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]] and [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]] patronizing the establishment, the heroes were able to glean some information as to where the criminal had gone.<ref name="TAUT" />
